name: MagicBot Gen1
summary:
MagicBot Gen1 is MagicLab's full-size humanoid platform for locomotion, manipulation and coordinated industrial demonstrations. The manufacturer describes 42 degrees of freedom and a perception system combining lidar, fisheye cameras and RGB-D cameras on the head and waist.

Its application direction includes flexible manufacturing and collaboration between multiple robots. Published demonstrations emphasize straight-knee walking and whole-body motion, while the product specification lists a single-arm load of up to 7.5 kg. That figure is distinct from the stated static whole-body load. Naviga

MagicBot Gen1 is MagicLab's full-size humanoid platform for locomotion, manipulation and coordinated industrial demonstrations. The manufacturer describes 42 degrees of freedom and a perception system combining lidar, fisheye cameras and RGB-D cameras on the head and waist.

Its application direction includes flexible manufacturing and collaboration between multiple robots. Published demonstrations emphasize straight-knee walking and whole-body motion, while the product specification lists a single-arm load of up to 7.5 kg. That figure is distinct from the stated static whole-body load. Navigation, sensing and task software are combined to develop applications in environments with changing objects and terrain.
